items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Ida always fixes what I used to like to eat over there... Bill Phillips always been a very, very great friend of mine.

ctx.x: And he has a vegetable truck and he's doing very well.

Good. I visit Bill every time I go to New Orleans and Ida always fixes what I used to like to eat over there and every time I go there I say, Don, I've got your dish cooked for you. What's that? Dumbo and rice. Yeah. That's right. And I go over there and Bill just stacks up my automobile with all the fruit. Oh yeah? And I can't pay him for it. I try to pay, he says no you don't pay. Probably hit you with his bass drum beater. And he also played my wedding. See when I left New Orleans I was a kid but I was engaged…
Now did you tell me what your motto was? You did, didn't you, the greatest swing band?
